unrestrictedTimeAndManualRecoveryAmendme.onHang: Preserve off-host evidence, stop physical iteration, and await owner reboot. Resume only after a fresh identity and health observation; do not label a new boot as a suspend return.
unrestrictedTimeAndManualRecoveryAmendme.trialRequirements: Explicit hypothesis, one variable, immutable pre/post evidence, finite wake and observation bounds, no RTC/EFI recorder or clock-repair replay. A black-box kernel A/B may narrow a regression without claiming low-level instruction proof.
unrestrictedTimeAndManualRecoveryAmendme.historicalEvidence: Preserve old sealed policies, original guards and incomplete cleanup results unchanged. This amendment is prospective, not a rewritten outcome.

autonomousKernelComparisonAmendment.initialComparison: At most three 90-second RTC-only trials per matched kernel arm, with fresh post-return evidence before each next trial. Stop that sequence at the first nonreturn and reassess the best discriminator.
autonomousKernelComparisonAmendment.onHang: Preserve identity, request and off-host evidence, then ask through the input tool for owner recovery. A new boot is recovery, never a successful suspend return. No blind replay or forced remote reset of an unreachable system.
autonomousKernelComparisonAmendment.continuation: Immediately perform available useful preparation and tests. Keep one recurring continuation bound to this thread, explicitly requiring the next task/test after each result. Reconsider the highest-information discriminator every time. Ask through the input tool for missing human input. Pause only for a genuine dependency, solved investigation or cancellation.
autonomousKernelComparisonAmendment.comparisonValidity: Review configuration drift. Use matched current/LTS variants from one frozen baseline and test the current-kernel control after a baseline change; record unavoidable kernel ABI/module/initrd differences.
autonomousKernelComparisonAmendment.additionalWork: Qualify an actual independent low-level capture channel, verify exact-model firmware release information, and keep s2idle WoL separate. Firmware flashing is not a justified experiment without applicability and recovery evidence.
autonomousKernelComparisonAmendment.historicalPolicy: Supersedes earlier prohibitions on planned reboots and kernel activation prospectively. Sealed historical policies and trial guards remain unchanged. RTC clock/calendar writes, phase-recorder replay and guessed-register access are not part of this plan.
